## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sebastianfoerste/awesome-eu-fintech-regulation/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full rules.

- [ ] One entry per pull request.
- [ ] Entry format: `- [Name](url) - One sentence, ending with a period.`
- [ ] Placed in the right section, in the order CONTRIBUTING.md sets out.
- [ ] It is a primary source (EUR-Lex, a regulator or register, an official Level 2/3 measure), a genuinely open-source tool (OSI license, public repo, runs without a paid account), or a free tracker or guide of lasting value. Not a law-firm alert, blog post or vendor marketing page.
- [ ] The link works and does not redirect to a marketing page or paywall.
- [ ] Level 2 entries only: the status line uses the fixed wording in CONTRIBUTING.md and is dated.
- [ ] Disclosure: if I maintain or work on the linked project, I have said so above.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes.
